reason: In config/initializers/i18n.rb:12-24, FallbackLocaleList subclasses Hash instead of I18n::Locale::Fallbacks and overrides [] to return only [locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact, dropping standard locale-ancestor fallback resolution. Consequently, regional locales such as :pt_BR (which has a matching base locale in config/locales/server.pt.yml containing keys absent from config/locales/server.pt_BR.yml) and hyphenated regional tags skip base-language translations and fall back directly to SiteSetting.default_locale and :en.
